_comment: qwen3_coder_xml output on origin/main for calls to undeclared tools (issue #4038). 'main_non_stream' / 'main_stream' (StreamingPostProcessor incl. finalize, keyed by delta size; 0 = the whole text as one delta) are captured from origin/main and must not change unless the case is 'changed_by_4038'. 'after_drop_main' is origin/main's output for the text that follows a dropped leading block. 'stream_overrides' pins the few streaming results of unchanged cases that differ from origin/main. Regenerate main_* / after_drop_main only from origin/main.
